Dharampal Satyapal Limited And Anr vs Food Safety
Commissioner, State Of ... on 14 March, 2024 
Author: G. S. Kulkarni
Bench: G. S. Kulkarni
 2-Wp
Ashvini Narwade
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Civil Appellate Jurisdition
 Writ Petition No.862 Of 2024
 Dharampal Satyapal Limited and Anr. ... Petit
 Versus
 Food Safety Commissioner, State of Maharashtra & Anr. ... Respondents
 Mr. Vivek Kohli, Sr. Advocate a/w. Mr. Sanjai K. Pathak, Mr. Nalin K.
 Talwar, Mr. Aashish Kaushik and Mr. Yashwardhan Tiwari i/b. M/s.
 Panicker Deepa for the Petitioners.
 Mr. Kedar B. Dighe, Addl. G. P a/w. Smt. P. J. Gavhane, Agp for State. 
 Ms. Sukanya Bhaumik for Respondent No.2-FSSAI.
 _____________________ __  CORAM: G. S. KULKARNI &
 FIRDOSH P. POONIWALLA, JJ.
 DATED: 14th MARCH, 2024  _______________________  P.C.
1. Leave to amend to implead the Union of India as also the State of Maharashtra as party Respondents. Amendments to be carried out forthwith. 
2. Issue notice to the newly added Respondents returnable after two weeks.
3. The Reply Affidavit to the Petition be placed on record by the added Respondents. 
4. Rule on the Writ Petition. Rule on the interim relief is made returnable after two weeks.
